text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week successfully finishes her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume aiming to be number one in Japan, she chooses the Japanese Derby as her next major goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But first, she sets off to race in the Kisaragi Sho as a stepping stone.
